example.description: Compute the first derivative of y=x² at the interior point of a nonuniform grid.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.geometry.sampling import diff_central

x = np.array([0.0, 0.3, 1.0])
np.testing.assert_allclose(diff_central(x, x * x), [0.6])
